plan.root_cause: The offcanvas component always treats itself as a modal dialog, enforcing focus trapping and setting aria-modal=true role=dialog regardless of the backdrop setting, preventing tab navigation to elements outside the offcanvas when backdrop is false (non-modal panel).
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the Offcanvas show and hide methods to conditionally apply modal attributes and focus enforcement only when the backdrop option is true, allowing the offcanvas to behave as a non-modal panel when backdrop:false.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users can tab off the offcanvas to interact with page controls when the panel is non-modal, restoring logical tab order and focus management without breaking modal behavior for true backdrop cases.
functional_risks: Changing the attributes may affect screen reader perception of the offcanvas as a dialog when backdrop is false; however the panel remains visible and accessible.

Removing focus trapping could allow focus to leave the panel unintentionally if developers rely on it for modal behavior; but we guard by only changing when backdrop false, preserving existing modal behavior.
verification_requirements: Ensure that when data-bs-backdrop="false" the offcanvas does not trap focus and allows tabbing to subsequent elements; when data-bs-backdrop="true" (default) it continues to trap focus and behave as a modal.
Verify that aria-modal and role attributes are present only when backdrop true, and that the panel still opens/closes correctly.

plan.root_cause: The offcanvas component unconditionally applies modal dialog semantics (aria-modal=true, role=dialog, focus trapping) regardless of the backdrop configuration, causing non-modal panels (data-bs-backdrop='false') to trap focus and prevent tab navigation to external elements.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the show() and hide() methods to conditionally apply modal attributes and focus enforcement only when this._config.backdrop is true, allowing non-modal offcanvas panels to coexist with page content without focus trapping.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: When data-bs-backdrop='false', the offcanvas panel will no longer trap focus or announce itself as a modal dialog, allowing keyboard users to tab freely between the panel and surrounding page controls. When data-bs-backdrop='true' (default), modal behavior is preserved.
functional_risks: Changing attribute management may affect screen reader perception when backdrop toggles dynamically; however, the panel's visibility and accessibility remain intact.

Removing focus trapping for non-modal panels could allow focus to leave the panel unintentionally if developers rely on it for modal behavior; but we guard by only changing when backdrop is false, preserving existing modal behavior.
verification_requirements: Ensure that when data-bs-backdrop='false' the offcanvas does not trap focus and allows tabbing to subsequent elements; when data-bs-backdrop='true' it continues to trap focus and behave as a modal.
Verify that aria-modal and role attributes are present only when backdrop is true, and that the panel still opens/closes correctly.
